highlight.note: The header: the mark, where you are, Normal / Technical, the Credits chip, the bell, your account and Sign out (below 1,100 px the mode and Sign out are in the account menu).
The band totals the whole organisation: its five figures, its workers and New idea.
Every 15 seconds the tree is read again while the tab is in focus, so the figures stay live.

variations.title: At the overdraft limit the Credits chip's dot turns red

highlight.note: Northwind is at its overdraft limit: the Credits chip's dot turns red, and it still leads to Credits.

variations.title: Someone granted one division sees only its figures
